svg.aria-label: Upper panel: the density of an isothermal self-gravitating sphere divided by its central density, against the dimensionless radius, on logarithmic axes. It is flat in the core and then falls, oscillating about the singular isothermal sphere which is drawn as a dashed line of slope minus two. A vertical line marks the critical dimensionless radius 6.4508. Lower panel: the dimensionless mass against the dimensionless radius. It rises to a maximum of 1.1822 at the critical radius and falls again; the stable branch is left of the maximum and the unstable branch right of it, and Barnard 68 is marked with an error bar on the unstable branch.
svg.text: The pressure-bounded isothermal sphere has no surface of its own
The criterion is the MAXIMUM of the mass, not the mass
its mass is only 0.23% below the maximum
